lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently degraded performance across 2 tests and led to early stops.

Home wait-info updates (4 wins across 8 tests), adoption redesigns (2 wins across 5 tests), and finish redesigns (2 wins across 8 tests) yielded clear wins, though several tests in these categories showed no clear effect.

Choose-path layout changes (4 tests), choose-path copy (3 tests), sign-in hints (4 tests), sign-in notifications (4 tests), and sign-in copy (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or degraded performance.
Kinds of change tested only once (such as adoption incentives, adoption notifications, or finish notifications) still provide thin evidence.
Predictions consistently underestimated large winning changes while overestimating changes that produced no clear effect or degraded performance.

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_storyline_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate layout into a story scroll presentation with an enhanced certificate badge.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is 87.7% with high median duration (89s); strengthening emotional context helps user commitment before rendering.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.certificate' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'preview'] with an asset:certificate/ asset

candidates.title: waiting_screen_desktop_pet_preview_flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive pet preview component to the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: Home funnel step takes a long mean duration (2336s) and median (201s). Keeping users engaged reduces drop-off during rendering.

guard.reason: Adding an interactive pet render preview to the waiting screen is a valid onboarding enhancement.

candidates.score_note: Home step drop-off is low (3.3%). Requires custom preview flow component.

candidates.title: new_screen_pet_desktop_gestures
candidates.change: Insert a new screen at the end of onboarding detailing desktop pet gestures, hiding, and pet interaction controls.
candidates.why: Support mail highlights post-onboarding confusion: 'Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet' (3 emails).

new_screen_pet_desktop_gestures.body: Learn how to drag, summon, talk to, or hide your pet anytime on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a new screen after home_intro detailing desktop controls is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drop-off is ~10.7% with 3 support emails. Finish new screen historically strong (+3.4%).

candidates.score_note: Finish new_flow historically shows weak results (+0.5% over 3 tests).

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info updates are proven (+1.9% across 8 tests, 4 wins) and low cost.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in has highest drop-off (27.1%) and 8 support tickets, but sign-in hints consistently show no clear effect.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently degraded performance across multiple tests and led to early stops.

Home wait-info updates (4 wins across 8 tests), adoption redesigns (2 wins across 5 tests), and finish redesigns (2 wins across 8 tests) produced clear wins, though several tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
Choose-path layout changes (4 tests), choose-path copy (3 tests), and sign-in notifications (4 tests) consistently resulted in no clear effect or degraded performance.
Kinds of change tested only once (such as adoption incentives, adoption notifications, or sign-in incentives) still provide thin evidence.
Predictions systematically underestimated major winning changes while overpredicting changes that had no clear effect or caused performance drops.
